messages:
Ana: Quick q — when someone pins a per-route filter in the console, what copy should we show to indicate quota/routing implications? Users keep assuming it's global. Need a very short helptext + icon. cc @Priya
Devon: Strong :+1: on explicit badge. Something like `Route-only` with a tooltip. Also we should show a small cost peek (token delta) if we can.
Priya: Short copy options: 1) Badge: "Route-only" tooltip: "Applies only to this route. May affect quota for this route." 2) Compact: "Route-only · may increase cost" (for tiny screens). Prefer #1 for clarity.
Sam: Telemetry note: we should emit an event when users pin/unpin so we can measure confusion. Suggested event: `console.filter.pin` payload (sample):
```
{
  "event": "console.filter.pin",
  "route_id": "route_123",
  "user_id": "u_456",
  "scope": "route",
  "previous_scope": "global|none",
  "user_tier": "self-serve|enterprise",
  "timestamp": 1714441234
}
```
Devon: Also API change: saved query object should include `scope` and optional `quota_hint` so console can display human copy without extra lookups. e.g.:
```
{
  "id": "sq_789",
  "name": "Errors last 24h",
  "filters": [...],
  "scope": "route", // route | model | global
  "scope_id": "route_123", // when scope is route/model
  "quota_hint": "+~20 tokens/req"
}
```
Ana: For rollout, can we A/B test tooltip vs badge? My plan: 10% tooltip-only, 40% badge-with-tooltip, 50% badge+cost-peek. Want to see which reduces support pings.
Priya: UX nit: badge label should be 1–2 words. Icon: shield or map-pin? leaning map-pin. Tooltip copy final candidate: "Applies only to this route. This change does not affect other routes or global filters." Add small cost line if `quota_hint` present: "Estimated effect: +~20 tokens per request."
Devon: I'll add `scope` + `quota_hint` to the saved-query API PR and a console flag for rollout. I'll also wire the telemetry event Sam suggested.
deploy-bot: Created PR #1234: add-savedquery-scope-and-quota-hint to api/backend (CI queued) :gear:
Ana: Perfect, thanks — I'll draft final microcopy and send a short design token for the badge (colors + icon). :thumbsup:
